success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the savings account using get_account_balance and tells the user the balance.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Initially ask to check the checking account balance. After the assistant shows the checking balance, change your mind and ask to see the savings account balance instead.
